# DatePickerTimezoneFix Shadow Spec

> DatePickerTimezoneFix - Corrects the one-day drift in Compose DatePicker by translating between device-local start-of-day and UTC start-of-day when reading/writing the picker's selected date

**Status:** Planned
**Generated by:** spec-lead

## Data Model

```sudolang
// No new domain models. The date field in CreateTransactionRequest
// remains a Long representing Unix epoch milliseconds.
//
// The invariant being fixed:
//   - Stored dates are device-local start-of-day millis
//   - Compose DatePicker interprets initialSelectedDateMillis as UTC
//   - Without conversion, non-UTC timezones drift by one day

// New utility signatures (added to DateUtils)
fn toUtcDayStartMillis(localDayStartMillis: Long, timeZone: TimeZone): Long
  // Extracts year/month/day from localDayStartMillis in the given timeZone,
  // then constructs the epoch millis for that same calendar day at 00:00 UTC.

fn toLocalDayStartMillis(utcDayStartMillis: Long, timeZone: TimeZone): Long
  // Extracts year/month/day from utcDayStartMillis in UTC,
  // then constructs the epoch millis for that same calendar day
  // at 00:00 in the given timeZone.
```

---

## Constraints

```sudolang
Constraint: All dates stored in the database remain as device-local start-of-day millis (existing invariant unchanged)
Constraint: DatePicker always receives UTC-aligned millis via toUtcDayStartMillis()
Constraint: DatePicker confirm output is converted back to local millis via toLocalDayStartMillis()
Constraint: The userManuallyChangedDate flag from the previous fix is preserved — auto-updates at midnight only apply when user has not manually picked a date
Constraint: No raw hex, dp, or sp values introduced — all tokens from BudgetCalendarTheme
Constraint: Both TransactionFormSheet and AddSandboxTransactionSheet must use the same conversion pattern
```

---

## Data Flow

```sudolang
// Open Date Picker Flow
User taps Date field |> showDatePicker = true
  |> rememberDatePickerState(initialSelectedDateMillis = toUtcDayStartMillis(selectedDateMillis, TimeZone.currentSystemDefault()))
  |> DatePicker renders with correct calendar day highlighted

// Confirm Date Picker Flow
User taps OK |> datePickerState.selectedDateMillis (UTC-aligned)
  |> toLocalDayStartMillis(utcMillis, TimeZone.currentSystemDefault())
  |> selectedDateMillis = result
  |> userManuallyChangedDate = true
  |> showDatePicker = false

// Auto-update at Midnight Flow (from previous fix, unchanged)
LaunchedEffect(initialDateMillis) |> If (!isEditMode && !userManuallyChangedDate)
  |> selectedDateMillis = DateUtils.startOfDayMillis(initialDateMillis)
```

// Updated composable usages (no signature changes):
fn TransactionFormSheet(...)
  // Internal: selectedDateMillis → toUtcDayStartMillis() when opening picker
  // Internal: datePicker result → toLocalDayStartMillis() on confirm

  // Internal: selectedDateMillis → toUtcDayStartMillis() when opening picker
  // Internal: datePicker result → toLocalDayStartMillis() on confirm

---

## Edge Cases

| Case | Condition | Handling |
|------|-----------|----------|
| UTC timezone | Device timezone is UTC | toUtcDayStartMillis and toLocalDayStartMillis are identity functions — no drift occurs |
| Negative UTC offset | Device timezone is UTC-5 (e.g. EST) | Local midnight = 05:00 UTC same day; conversion extracts correct calendar day |
| Positive UTC offset | Device timezone is UTC+8 (e.g. PHT) | Local midnight = 16:00 UTC previous day; conversion corrects to same calendar day UTC |
| User manually picks date | userManuallyChangedDate = true | Conversion still applies — picker opens on correct day, confirm stores correct local millis |
| Edit mode | initialData != null | Transaction's stored date converted to UTC for picker, back to local on confirm |
| Midnight rollover during form open | LaunchedEffect(initialDateMillis) fires | selectedDateMillis auto-updates only if userManuallyChangedDate is false |
